```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800">
  <defs>
    <!-- Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="skyGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B0E2FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFF9C4"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFEB3B"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="groundGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D2B48C"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A0522D"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="dirtGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8B4513"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5C4033"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="excavatorBody" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cabGlass" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E0FFFF" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B0E0E6" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="vestGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF4500"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF8C00"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hatGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFD700"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFA500"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="trackPattern" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="20" height="40">
      <rect width="20" height="40" fill="#555"/>
      <rect x="5" y="5" width="10" height="30" fill="#333"/>
    </pattern>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.4"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#skyGrad)"/>

  <!-- Sun with gentle pulsing -->
  <circle cx="900" cy="150" r="60" fill="url(#sunGrad)">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="60;65;60" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Clouds drifting slowly -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.8">
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="120" rx="40" ry="20"/>
    <ellipse cx="330" cy="130" rx="50" ry="25"/>
    <ellipse cx="700" cy="200" rx="35" ry="18"/>
    <ellipse cx="730" cy="210" rx="45" ry="22"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="200 0" dur="40s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="500" width="1200" height="300" fill="url(#groundGrad)"/>

  <!-- Dirt pile -->
  <path d="M100,500 Q300,400 500,500 Q700,600 900,500 L900,800 L100,800 Z" fill="url(#dirtGrad)"/>

  <!-- Construction details -->
  <!-- Caution stripe -->
  <rect x="200" y="550" width="200" height="20" fill="#FFD700">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <rect x="200" y="570" width="200" height="20" fill="#FF4500"/>

  <!-- Cones -->
  <polygon points="800,520 820,560 780,560" fill="#FF4500"/>
  <polygon points="850,540 870,580 830,580" fill="#FF4500"/>

  <!-- Rocks -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="580" rx="15" ry="10" fill="#708090"/>
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="600" rx="20" ry="12" fill="#708090"/>

  <!-- Excavator -->
  <g id="excavator" filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <!-- Left track -->
    <g id="left-track">
      <rect x="300" y="600" width="200" height="40" fill="url(#trackPattern)" rx="5"/>
      <!-- Rollers -->
      <circle cx="330" cy="620" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 330 620" to="360 330 620" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <circle cx="370" cy="620" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 370 620" to="360 370 620" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <circle cx="410" cy="620" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 410 620" to="360 410 620" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
    </g>

    <!-- Right track (mirrored) -->
    <g id="right-track">
      <rect x="500" y="600" width="200" height="40" fill="url(#trackPattern)" rx="5"/>
      <circle cx="530" cy="620" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 530 620" to="360 530 620" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <circle cx="570" cy="620" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 570 620" to="360 570 620" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <circle cx="610" cy="620" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 610 620" to="360 610 620" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
    </g>

    <!-- Main body -->
    <rect x="350" y="550" width="150" height="50" fill="url(#excavatorBody)" rx="10"/>

    <!-- Cab -->
    <g id="cab">
      <rect x="420" y="520" width="80" height="60" fill="url(#excavatorBody)" rx="8"/>
      <!-- Window -->
      <rect x="430" y="530" width="60" height="40" fill="url(#cabGlass)"/>
      <!-- Steering wheel -->
      <circle cx="470" cy="560" r="10" fill="#333">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 470 560" to="360 470 560" dur="8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </circle>
      <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
      <rect x="500" y="540" width="10" height="10" fill="#555"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Arm assembly -->
    <g id="arm">
      <!-- Boom -->
      <g id="boom">
        <rect x="500" y="450" width="20" height="100" fill="#8B4513"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
          values="0 500 550; -25 500 550; 0 500 550; 25 500 550; 0 500 550"
          keyTimes="0; 0.25; 0.5; 0.75; 1"
          dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        <!-- Stick (attached to boom tip) -->
        <g id="stick" transform="translate(510,450)">
          <rect x="-10" y="-100" width="20" height="100" fill="#8B4513"/>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
            values="0; 30; 0; -30; 0"
            keyTimes="0; 0.25; 0.5; 0.75; 1"
            dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <!-- Bucket -->
          <g id="bucket" transform="translate(0,-100)">
            <g id="bucket-rotate">
              <path d="M-15,0 L15,0 L20,-20 L-20,-20 Z" fill="#8B4513"/>
              <!-- Teeth -->
              <rect x="-5" y="-25" width="4" height="5" fill="#555"/>
              <rect x="1" y="-25" width="4" height="5" fill="#555"/>
              <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate"
                values="0; 20; 0; -20; 0"
                keyTimes="0; 0.25; 0.5; 0.75; 1"
                dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
            </g>
          </g>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Sloth in cab -->
  <g id="sloth">
    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx="470" cy="540" r="20" fill="#D2B48C"/>
    <!-- Eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx="460" cy="535" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#333"/>
    <ellipse cx="480" cy="535" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#333"/>
    <!-- Eyes (blink) -->
    <g id="sloth-eyes">
      <circle cx="460" cy="535" r="2" fill="#000"/>
      <circle cx="480" cy="535" r="2" fill="#000"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0;1" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Nose -->
    <circle cx="470" cy="545" r="2" fill="#333"/>
    <!-- Sleepy smile -->
    <path d="M465,550 Q470,555 475,550" stroke="#333" fill="none" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Arm toward steering wheel -->
    <line x1="470" y1="560" x2="500" y2="560" stroke="#D2B48C" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Claws -->
    <line x1="500" y1="560" x2="505" y2="555" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="500" y1="560" x2="505" y2="560" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="500" y1="560" x2="505" y2="565" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Hard hat -->
    <path d="M450,520 L490,520 L485,505 L455,505 Z" fill="url(#hatGrad)"/>
    <!-- High-vis vest -->
    <rect x="455" y="550" width="30" height="20" fill="url(#vestGrad)"/>

    <!-- Zzz when drifting off -->
    <g id="zzz" opacity="0">
      <text x="470" y="510" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" fill="#333">Z</text>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" keyTimes="0;0.5;1" dur="6s" begin="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="0 -50" dur="6s" begin="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Exhaust puffs -->
  <g id="exhaust">
    <circle cx="505" cy="535" r="3" fill="#777">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="3;8;3" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="505" cy="535" r="3" fill="#777">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="3;8;3" dur="2s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1;0" dur="2s" begin="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Bird crossing sky -->
  <g id="bird" transform="translate(-50,300)">
    <path d="M0,0 Q10,-10 20,0 Q30,-10 40,0" stroke="#333" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="1300 0" dur="20s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```
